articles.title: How to Reset Your Password
articles.content:
To reset your password:

1. Click on 'Forgot Password' on the login page
2. Enter your email address
3. Check your email for a password reset link (check spam folder if not found)
4. Click the link and enter your new password
5. Your new password must be at least 8 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, and numbers

If you don't receive the email within 5 minutes, contact support.

articles.title: How to Update Billing Information
articles.content:
To update your billing information:

1. Log into your account
2. Navigate to Settings > Billing
3. Click 'Payment Methods'
4. Click 'Add New Card' or 'Edit' on existing card
5. Enter your card details and billing address
6. Click 'Save'

Changes take effect immediately. Your next charge will use the updated payment method.

articles.title: How to Export Your Data
articles.content:
To export your data:

1. Go to Settings > Data & Privacy
2. Click 'Export Data'
3. Select the data types you want to export (messages, files, settings)
4. Choose format: CSV or JSON
5. Click 'Request Export'
6. You'll receive an email whenyour export is ready (usually within 24 hours)
7. Download your data from the link in the email

Export links expire after 7 days.

articles.title: Troubleshooting Login Issues
articles.content:
If you're having trouble logging in:

1. Verifyyou're using the correct email address
2. Check if Caps Lock is on
3. Clear your browser cache and cookies
4. Try a different browser or incognito mode
5. Reset your password if you've forgotten it
6. Check if your account has been locked (too many failed attempts - wait 30 minutes)

If the problem persists, contact support with your email and a screenshot of the error message.

articles.title: How to Cancel Your Subscription
articles.content:
To cancel your subscription:

1. Go to Settings> Billing > Subscription
2. Click 'Manage Subscription'
3. Click'Cancel Subscription'
4. Select a reason for canceling (helps us improve)
5. Confirm cancellation

Your account remains active until the end of your current billing period. You won't be charged again. You can reactivate anytime before the period ends.

articles.title: How to Enable Two-Factor Authentication
articles.content:
To enable two-factor authentication (2FA):

1. Go to Settings > Security
2. Click 'Enable Two-Factor Authentication'
3. Choose your method: SMS or Authenticator App (app recommended)
4. For app: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator or Authy
5. Enter the 6-digit code to verify
6. Save your backup codes in a safe place

2FA adds an extra layer of security to your account. We highly recommend enabling it.

articles.title: Understanding Your Bill
articles.content:
Your bill includes:

1. Subscription Fee: Your plan's monthly cost
2. Usage Charges: Any usage beyond your plan limits
3. Add-ons: Extra features you've purchased
4. Taxes: Applied based on your location

Bills are generated on your billing date each month. You can view detailed breakdowns in Settings > Billing > Invoices. Download PDFs for your records.

articles.title: How to Invite Team Members
articles.content:
To invite team members:

1. Go to Settings > Team
2. Click 'Invite Member'
3. Enter their email address
4. Select their role (Admin, Member, or Viewer)
5. Click 'Send Invitation'

They'll receive an email invitation. The invite expires in 7 days. You can manage roles and remove members from theTeam settings page. Admin role required to invite members.
